brand.name: Shinã
brand.concept: Modern car rental platform (owners + renters). Futuristic, seductive, technological. Glowing blue/purple plasma 'S' on near-black background.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-white
rules.overline: uppercase text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 to-purple-500

layouts.spacing: Generous scaling: p-8, p-12, p-24, gap-12, gap-24. High breathing room.

grid_modes.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-8, col-span-4 for aggressive asymmetry.
grid_modes.feature_showcase: Split-Screen Comparison layout. 50% sticky text/prompt, 50% scrolling visual output.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tech-Glass (Telematics) combined with Cinema-Black. Deep cockpit black (#050508) with frosted translucent panels (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.gradients: No flat gradients. Use mesh/plasma gradient glows blurred heavily (blur-3xl) placed behind key elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: The Tracing Beam (Aceternity style) on high-conversion cards like Pricing/CTA.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on dark backgrounds to kill digital flatness.

motion.reveals: Framer Motion line-by-line masked text reveals on headings (Kinetic Typography).
motion.interactions: Parallax depth effects on hover. Hovering cards tilts them slightly (rotateX/Y) with glare effect.
motion.marquee: Very slow editorial marquee for AI features/differentiators, massive outline text (text-8xl).

sections_blueprint.purpose: Kinetic Hero with signature on-load reveal.
sections_blueprint.components: Header (transparent glass), language toggle (PT/EN), massive 'Unbounded' heading masked reveal. Background uses abstract neon waves (plasma). CTA 'Conheça'. 3D Parallax floating car image.
Numbered chapters. Brutalist large typography. High contrast.
Sticky vertical timeline. As user scrolls, steps highlight. CTA 'Veja como funciona'.
Bento Grid (Mode A). Asymmetric cards with subtle 3D hover effects. Deep dark surfaces.
Tech-Glass HUD feel. Background Marquee running large outlined text.
Showroom Scroll. Real car photography treated deliberately with spotlights. Clipped frames.
Numbers running fast, realistic avatars, high-end quotes. 'Descubra a Plataforma' CTA.
Shadcn Accordion, heavily customized (dark borders, glowing active state, no backgrounds).
Pricing cards with 'Tracing Beam' border effect. Glowing CTA buttons. 'Comece agora'.

hero_car.description: Luxury sports car at dark night, use for parallax hero or showroom.

plasma_background.description: Abstract purple/blue neon waves. Use as blur-3xl background glowing effect behind elements.

driver_lifestyle.description: Driver in dark dramatic lighting. Use for locador/locatário storytelling.

showroom_car.description: Yellow/black car in dark room for stark contrast, perfect for split-screen demo section.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup PT/EN i18n context or simple state toggle to flip content seamlessly.
2. Ensure all texts have high contrast against deep black backgrounds. Use text-white for headings and text-zinc-400 for body.
3. Do not use plain Shadcn Cards. Use HTML/Tailwind to build custom glassmorphism containers (bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-2xl, border-white/10).
4. Add Framer Motion initial/animate logic for scroll reveals. Text must reveal line-by-line using a hidden/visible stagger pattern.
5. Avoid 'Inter' entirely. Import 'Unbounded' and 'Outfit' via Google Fonts.
6. Hero image overlay must be a gradient from black/80 at the bottom to transparent at the top, ensuring the car is visible but text is readable.
7. Include `data-testid` on ALL interactive elements (buttons, language toggles, accordion triggers, CTA).
8. CTA 'Entrar' in the nav should visually pop (e.g., glowing purple/blue border) and link to '#login'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition like 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, avoid '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles, pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use the specified icon library.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
